info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Market Analysis API
info.description: The Financial Market Analysis API enables users to submit requests for comprehensive analyses of market data. This service is designed for financial analysts and institutions seeking to generate in-depth insights into market trends, risks, and opportunities. By leveraging the endpoint, users can customize their analyses based on specific parameters to meet their analytical needs. Typical consumers include investment firms, research organizations, and fintech companies aiming to enhance their data-driven decision-making processes.

post.summary: Create a new financial market analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new financial market analysis by providing the necessary parameters. The created analysis will help in understanding market trends and making informed investment decisions.
